verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official MCP server (confirmed by docs and probe) that lets AI assistants like Claude or Cursor interact with and query Supabase projects via natural language, and community evidence (the Cursor+Supabase MCP incident) confirms this integration is used in real hands-on workflows, not just a paper feature. Missing for 10: broader documentation of the full scope of natural-language operations beyond querying (e.g., schema changes, admin tasks) and clearer production-safety guidance, which commenters note is currently absent.
